result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but there are a few noticeable clipping and incomplete-state issues near the horizontal carousels and fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The next restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is visibly cut off at the right edge, including its title (“Trattoria Piccol...”) and delivery text. While a partially visible card can indicate horizontal scrolling, the text appears abruptly truncated and crowded against the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have consistent side padding and intentional partial-card treatment, or clip card content cleanly so titles and metadata do not appear accidentally cut off.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right, with part of an additional chip visible but no clear continuation affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding, a subtle fade/scroll indicator, or use a layout that makes horizontal scrolling more obvious.

issues.description: The next “Popular right now” card continues beneath the fixed bottom navigation, leaving the visible card content partially obscured at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding for the fixed navigation bar so feed cards can scroll fully above it.

issues.description: The circular control at the upper-right only shows a small red dot and otherwise looks like an empty placeholder, making its purpose unclear.
issues.suggestion: Show the intended profile/avatar or notification icon, or replace the empty circle with a recognizable action icon and accessible label.
